## Options
| Option | Syntax | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow-unsigned-development-rules` | `` | Refused: external rule packs are not admitted, so no pack can be selected. Default: false. |
| `--approved-domain` | `<host>` | Treat this hostname as approved for UNAPPROVED_DOMAIN; repeatable. |
| `--audit-supply-chain` | `` | Emit canonical advisory status and request metadata; no admitted snapshot is available and no network is used. Default: false. |
| `--catalogue` | `<builtin>` | Select the embedded semantic catalogue. Default: builtin. |
| `--community-package` | `<package>` | Record a community package in target context; repeatable. |
| `--concurrency` | `<1..16>` | Bound concurrent inputs; --max-concurrency is an equivalent spelling. Default: 1. |
| `--config` | `<local-file>` | Load one explicit versioned config file. |
| `--configuration` | `<name>` | Record a configuration fact; repeatable. |
| `--confirm` | `` | Explicit confirmation; required for apply and refused for suggest. Default: false. |
| `--deployment` | `<SELF_HOSTED|CLOUD|UNKNOWN>` | Set the deployment fact. Default: UNKNOWN. |
| `--edition` | `<COMMUNITY|ENTERPRISE|CLOUD|UNKNOWN>` | Set the deployment edition fact. Default: UNKNOWN. |
| `--endpoint-receipt` | `<relative-file>` | Root-relative endpoint-compatibility receipt. |
| `--exclude` | `<posix-glob>` | Replace config excludes with a case-sensitive POSIX glob; repeatable. Default: .git/**, node_modules/**. |
| `--fail-on` | `<CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFO>` | Fail when a finding meets or exceeds this severity. Default: INFO. |
| `--fix` | `<fix-id>` | Select one reviewed fix; apply requires exactly one. |
| `--format` | `<json|ndjson|sarif|table>` | Select the output format. Default: json for scan; json for metadata. |
| `--help` | `` | Show deterministic help for the selected v2 command. |
| `--include` | `<posix-glob>` | Replace config includes with a case-sensitive POSIX glob; repeatable. Default: **/*.json. |
| `--include-readiness` | `` | Include preflight readiness assessment in json, ndjson, or table output. Default: false. |
| `--input` | `<relative-file>` | Root-relative workflow file; standard input cannot be re-read. |
| `--limits` | `<local-file|builtin>` | Select embedded or local scanner limits. Default: builtin. |
| `--mapping` | `<relative-file>` | Root-relative credential-mapping receipt. |
| `--max-concurrency` | `<1..16>` | Bound concurrent inputs; --concurrency is an equivalent spelling. Default: 1. |
| `--n8n-version` | `<semver>` | Set the n8n version fact. |
| `--no-color` | `` | Disable color in human output. Default: false (also disabled for non-TTY). |
| `--output` | `<local-file|->` | Write to a local file atomically, or use - for stdout. Default: stdout. |
| `--profile` | `<beta-default>` | Select the admitted analysis profile. Default: beta-default. |
| `--require-complete` | `` | Treat DEGRADED analysis as a failure. Default: false. |
| `--role` | `<OWNER|ADMIN|MEMBER|UNKNOWN>` | Set the operator role fact. Default: UNKNOWN. |
| `--root` | `<absolute-local-dir>` | Absolute local directory holding the workflow and receipts. |
| `--rules` | `<builtin>` | Select the embedded built-in ruleset; the only admitted authority. Default: builtin. |
| `--schema` | `<v2>` | Select the versioned v2 grammar. |
| `--target` | `<local-file>` | Load a local target context. |
| `--task-runner` | `<LEGACY|NATIVE|UNKNOWN>` | Set the task-runner fact. Default: UNKNOWN. |
| `--timeout` | `<1..2147483647>` | Set the per-input timeout in milliseconds. Default: 30000 (workerDeadlineMs). |

## Exit codes
| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | UNDER_THRESHOLD |
| `1` | FINDING_THRESHOLD, REQUIRE_COMPLETE |
| `2` | USAGE |
| `3` | ITEM_FAILURE |
| `4` | INTERNAL |
| `130` | CANCELLED |

## Exit reasons
- `CANCELLED`
- `FINDING_THRESHOLD`
- `INTERNAL`
- `ITEM_FAILURE`
- `REQUIRE_COMPLETE`
- `UNDER_THRESHOLD`
- `USAGE`

## Canonical claims
- v2 is offline and never initiates network requests (HTTP, DNS, sockets, telemetry, or remote imports).
- Labels and output identities never contain absolute paths or workflow source content.
- File output uses a same-directory temporary file and atomic replace; failures and cancellation preserve the prior file.
- beta-default@2.0.0 is admitted; beta-hardened@2.0.0 is defined but not admitted or selectable.
- No shipped path produces a redacted artifact: maxRedactionPatches and maxRedactedArtifactBytes bound redaction-v2, which is development-only and unwired.
- No shipped path admits an external rule pack: --rules and --catalogue accept only builtin, and --allow-unsigned-development-rules is refused because Ed25519 trust-store admission is deferred.
- Published on npm as sfscanner.
